column4: Show names, results and bulgarian commanders of the battles with no ships lost in the 'English Channel'.
column5: SELECT name ,  RESULT ,  bulgarian_commander FROM battle EXCEPT SELECT T1.name ,  T1.result ,  T1.bulgarian_commander FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle WHERE T2.location  =  'English Channel'
column6: SELECT T1.name ,  T1.result ,  T1.bulgarian_commander FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle WHERE T2.location != "English Channel"

column4: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.
column5: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed)  >  10
column6: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN death AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T2.caused_by_ship_id HAVING sum(T2.killed)  >  10

column4: What are the death and injury situations caused by the ship with tonnage 't'?

column4: Which distinctive models are produced by maker with the full name General Motors or weighing more than 3500?
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker  =  T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName  =  'General Motors' OR T4.weight  >  3500;
column6: SELECT T1.Model FROM model_list AS T1 JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model WHERE T1.Maker  =  1 OR T2.Weight  >  3500

column4: What is the name of each teacher and what course they teach?

column6: SELECT T2.Name ,  T1.Course FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN teacher AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T2.Teacher_ID

column4: What are the distinct template type descriptions for the templates ever used by any document?

column4: List the first name of all the professionals along with the description of the treatment they have done.

column6: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T3.treatment_type_description FROM professionals AS T1 JOIN treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id JOIN treatment_types AS T3 ON T2.treatment_type_code  =  T3.treatment_type_code

column4: Which airline has most number of flights?

column6: SELECT T1.Airline FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airlines AS T2 ON T1.Airline  =  T2.uid GROUP BY T1.Airline ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

column4: What are the id, name and membership level of visitors who have spent the largest amount of money in total in all museum tickets?

column6: SELECT T2.id ,  T2.name ,  T2.level_of_membership FROM VISIT AS T1 JOIN VISITOR AS T2 ON T1.visitor_id  =  T2.id ORDER BY T1.total_spent DESC LIMIT 1
